articles.title: Facing NPS remittance delays? Finance Ministry steps in with stern warning, errant officials risk penalties
articles.summary: The DoE reiterated that if an employee's monthly NPS contribution is credited past the established deadline, interest must be paid to the subscriber for the duration of the delay. This compensatory interest will match the prevailing PPF interest rate, which currently stands at 7.1%

articles.summary: Probate of a Will in India confirms its validity and gives legal authority to the executor. Check and understand the process, documents required, court procedure, recent changes, and when probate can help prevent inheritance disputes.

articles.title: Hospitalized? 10 essential steps for hassle-free health insurance claim settlement
articles.summary: Health insurance claims can become stressful during emergencies. These 10 practical steps, from hospital admission to discharge, ensure faster cashless claim settlement, avoid delays, manage documents properly and reduce financial pressure, especially during emergencies.

articles.title: From Form 26AS to contract notes: 6 tax documents every investor should preserve
articles.summary: All investors should preserve key tax documents such as Form 26AS, AIS, TIS, contract notes and mutual fund statements. These records ensure accurate ITR filing and help verify income. They are necessary to claim tax benefits, calculate capital gains and handle tax notices.

articles.title: Netflix shares tumble 13% after weak sales forecast, hit 22-month low
articles.summary: Netflix shares fell 12.6% to a 22-month low after a muted revenue outlook, despite Q2 results meeting expectations. The company's revenue growth is moderating, and it narrowed its 2026 guidance amid pressures from original content performance and declining stock value since mid-2025.

articles.summary: Until now, automatic instructions were available only for mutual fund units held in statement of account (SOA) form, where the fund house maintains the investment records

articles.title: Pulse of the Street: Earnings sentiment rescues volatile week; real test ahead
articles.summary: The 30-share Sensex rose 0.75% for the week, while the broader Nifty 50 gained 0.53%, with most of the gains coming on Friday. The Nifty jumped 1.1% to close at 24,334.30, while the Sensex advanced 1.25% to settle at 78,151.44, its highest closing level since 12 June 2026.

articles.title: Apple overtakes Nvidia as world's most valuable company amid chip selloff
articles.summary: Nvidia lost its title as the world's most valuable company to Apple after a selloff in semiconductor stocks. Nvidia shares fell 3.7%, while Apple's rose 0.4%, raising its market cap to $4.9 trillion amidst concerns over emerging AI competition from Chinese startups.

articles.title: Wall Street falls on deepening selloff in chip stocks, Netflix slumps10.6%, Nvidia tumbles 4%
articles.summary: As of 12:53 p.m. Eastern Time, the S&P 500 fell 0.5%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down 0.3%, and the Nasdaq Composite fell 0.7%.

articles.title: Reliance Q1 Results: Profit up 16% sans one-time income vs same quarter last year — 5 key highlights
articles.summary: Reliance Q1 results: Consolidated profit declined 22.40% YoY to ₹20,946 crore due to a one-time gain in Q1FY26. Sequentially, RIL's Q1FY27 profit rose by 23.42%. RIL's revenue from operations for the June quarter of FY27 rose by 25.41% YoY and 4.43% QoQ to ₹3,11,850 crore.

articles.title: Reliance Industries promoters raise stake during Q1FY26. Check details
articles.summary: Promoters of Reliance Industries increased their stake to 50.5% by June, the highest in over three years. Mutual funds also raised their holding to 10.11%. Analysts anticipate strong financial results driven by oil and telecom sectors despite retail challenges.

articles.title: Caliber Mining and Logistics IPO: Issue received a solid response on Day 01, booked 1.3 times
articles.summary: Caliber Mining and Logistics' IPO showed strong initial demand, with bids for 96.54 lakh shares against 74.29 lakh shares offered. The IPO, set at ₹402-424, will close on July 21. Grey market premium indicates a potential listing price of ₹529, 38% above the issue price.

articles.title: Oberoi Realty Q1 profit jumps 29% to ₹544 crore, revenue rises 32%; declares ₹2 interim dividend
articles.summary: Oberoi Realty reported Q1 FY27 net profit of ₹544 crore, up 29% YoY. Revenue rose 31.7% to ₹1,301 crore, with EBITDA increasing 41% to ₹734 crore. The company also declared an interim dividend of ₹2 per share as it continues to see strong demand for luxury homes.

articles.title: PB Fintech share price rises 3% after HDFC Mutual Fund stake raise to 5.02%
articles.summary: PB Fintech shares rose 3% intraday on July 17 after HDFC Mutual Fund increased its stake to 5.02% via an open market purchase. The fund acquired 129,068 shares, raising its holding slightly above the 5% threshold. Shares were bought through various mutual fund schemes.

articles.title: JSW Steel Q1 result: Net Profit doubles to ₹4,696 crore; revenue jumps 10%
articles.summary: JSW Steel reported a Q1 FY27 net profit of ₹4,696 crore, more than double last year’s ₹2,209 crore, driven by a 9.8% revenue increase to ₹47,364 crore. The company began construction on a new 2-million-tonne steel plant in Andhra Pradesh as part of its expansion.
